152464.name: bitbird
152464.bio: bitbird is a Dutch independent record label founded by San Holo in 2014, built on the principle of create forever, a commitment to lifelong creativity, evolution, and artistic freedom. Rooted in emotional electronic music and guided by artist-first values, bitbird champions forward-thinking sounds that transcend genres, pushing boundaries while amplifying the art and artists it believes in.

378148.name: Emengy Bass
378148.bio: Emengy Bass is a sub label to Emengy based in Vancouver British Columbia, Canada. Our goal has remained the same since founding Emengy Bass in 2014 - To identify and develop talented producers and artists, taking them first to fans and then to the marketplace through new paradigms, creative brand partnerships and front running third party platforms.
